interface_decision.semantic_role: the minimal generic action/orbit/stabilizer interface consumed by finite p-group counting
interface_decision.litex_form: one action predicate, orbit and stabilizer set interfaces, then an explicit G <-> orbit(x) x stabilizer(x) bijection

proof_spine: An action supplies identity and multiplication compatibility.
The stabilizer of x is a subgroup and every g sends x into its orbit.
Choose one group representative for every orbit point.
Split g into its orbit point and residual stabilizer coordinate.
The forward and backward coordinates are inverse, yielding orbit-stabilizer as an explicit bijection.

blocks.name: is_group_action

attempts.verifier_evidence: Literal outer try committed.

blocks.accepted_litex:
prop is_group_action(G nonempty_set, X set, group &group::Group<G>, act fn(g G, x X) X):
    forall x X:
        act(group.one, x) = x
    forall g, h G, x X:
        act(g, act(h, x)) = act(group.mul(g, h), x)

blocks.accepted_litex:
thm group_action_stabilizer_closed:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, X set, group &group::Group<G>, act fn(g G, x X) X, x X:
        $is_group_action(G, X, group, act)
        =>:
            $subgroup::is_subgroup(G, group, \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x))
    by def $group::group_laws(G, group.mul, group.one, group.inv)
    \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x) = {g G: $stabilizer_member(G, X, act, x, g)}
    act(group.one, x) = x
    release thm set_builder_member(group.one, {g G: $stabilizer_member(G, X, act, x, g)})
    group.one $in \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)
    claim:
        ? forall a, b G:
            a $in \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)
            b $in \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)
            =>:
                group.mul(a, b) $in \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)
        a $in {g G: $stabilizer_member(G, X, act, x, g)}
        b $in {g G: $stabilizer_member(G, X, act, x, g)}
        act(a, x) = x
        act(b, x) = x
        act(group.mul(a, b), x) = act(a, act(b, x)) = act(a, x) = x
        release thm set_builder_member(group.mul(a, b), {g G: $stabilizer_member(G, X, act, x, g)})
        group.mul(a, b) $in \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)
    claim:
        ? forall a G:
            a $in \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)
            =>:
                group.inv(a) $in \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)
        a $in {g G: $stabilizer_member(G, X, act, x, g)}
        act(a, x) = x
        release thm cosets::object_substitution(X, X, fn(y X) X {act(group.inv(a), y)}, act(a, x), x)
        act(group.inv(a), act(a, x)) = act(group.inv(a), x)
        group.mul(group.inv(a), a) = group.one
        act(group.inv(a), act(a, x)) = act(group.mul(group.inv(a), a), x) = act(group.one, x) = x
        act(group.inv(a), x) = x
        release thm set_builder_member(group.inv(a), {g G: $stabilizer_member(G, X, act, x, g)})
        group.inv(a) $in \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)
    by def $subgroup::is_subgroup(G, group, \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x))

thm orbit_projection_surjective:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, X set, group &group::Group<G>, act fn(g G, x X) X, x X:
        $is_group_action(G, X, group, act)
        =>:
            $surjective(G, \orbit<G, X, act>(x), \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>)
    claim:
        ? forall y \orbit<G, X, act>(x):
            exist source_g G st {y = \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(source_g)}
        \orbit<G, X, act>(x) = {candidate X: $orbit_member(G, X, act, x, candidate)}
        y $in {candidate X: $orbit_member(G, X, act, x, candidate)}
        by def $orbit_member(G, X, act, x, y)
        obtain preimage_g from $orbit_member(G, X, act, x, y)
        witness exist source_g G st {y = \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(source_g)} from preimage_g:
            \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(preimage_g) = act(preimage_g, x) = y
    by def $surjective(G, \orbit<G, X, act>(x), \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>)

    ? forall G nonempty_set, X set, group &group::Group<G>, act fn(g G, x X) X, x X, y \orbit<G, X, act>(x):

thm orbit_coordinate_mem_stabilizer:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, X set, group &group::Group<G>, act fn(g G, x X) X, x X, g G:
        $is_group_action(G, X, group, act)
        =>:
            group.mul(group.inv(\orbit_representative<G, X, group, act, x>(\orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(g))), g) $in \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)
    by def $group::group_laws(G, group.mul, group.one, group.inv)
    release thm orbit_representative_spec(G, X, group, act, x, \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(g))
    have representative_g G = \orbit_representative<G, X, group, act, x>(\orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(g))
    \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(representative_g) = \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(\orbit_representative<G, X, group, act, x>(\orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(g))) = \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(g)
    \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(representative_g) = act(representative_g, x)
    \orbit_projection<G, X, group, act, x>(g) = act(g, x)
    act(representative_g, x) = act(g, x)
    release thm cosets::object_substitution(X, X, fn(y X) X {act(group.inv(representative_g), y)}, act(representative_g, x), act(g, x))
    act(group.inv(representative_g), act(representative_g, x)) = act(group.inv(representative_g), act(g, x))
    group.mul(group.inv(representative_g), representative_g) = group.one
    act(group.inv(representative_g), act(representative_g, x)) = act(group.mul(group.inv(representative_g), representative_g), x) = act(group.one, x) = x
    act(group.inv(representative_g), act(g, x)) = act(group.mul(group.inv(representative_g), g), x)
    act(group.mul(group.inv(representative_g), g), x) = x
    \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x) = {h G: $stabilizer_member(G, X, act, x, h)}
    by def $stabilizer_member(G, X, act, x, group.mul(group.inv(representative_g), g))
    release thm set_builder_member(group.mul(group.inv(representative_g), g), {h G: $stabilizer_member(G, X, act, x, h)})
    group.mul(group.inv(representative_g), g) $in \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)

thm orbit_stabilizer_forward_bijective:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, X set, group &group::Group<G>, act fn(g G, x X) X, x X:
        $is_group_action(G, X, group, act)
        =>:
            $bijective(G, cart(\orbit<G, X, act>(x), \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)), \orbit_stabilizer_forward<G, X, group, act, x>)
    claim:
        ? $function_inverse::is_left_inverse(G, cart(\orbit<G, X, act>(x), \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)), \orbit_stabilizer_forward<G, X, group, act, x>, \orbit_stabilizer_backward<G, X, group, act, x>)
        claim:
            ? forall g G:
                \orbit_stabilizer_backward<G, X, group, act, x>(\orbit_stabilizer_forward<G, X, group, act, x>(g)) = g
            release thm orbit_stabilizer_backward_forward(G, X, group, act, x, g)
        by def $function_inverse::is_left_inverse(G, cart(\orbit<G, X, act>(x), \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)), \orbit_stabilizer_forward<G, X, group, act, x>, \orbit_stabilizer_backward<G, X, group, act, x>)
    release thm function_inverse::injective_of_left_inverse(G, cart(\orbit<G, X, act>(x), \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)), \orbit_stabilizer_forward<G, X, group, act, x>, \orbit_stabilizer_backward<G, X, group, act, x>)
    claim:
        ? $function_inverse::is_right_inverse(G, cart(\orbit<G, X, act>(x), \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)), \orbit_stabilizer_forward<G, X, group, act, x>, \orbit_stabilizer_backward<G, X, group, act, x>)
        claim:
            ? forall pair cart(\orbit<G, X, act>(x), \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)):
                \orbit_stabilizer_forward<G, X, group, act, x>(\orbit_stabilizer_backward<G, X, group, act, x>(pair)) = pair
            release thm orbit_stabilizer_forward_backward(G, X, group, act, x, pair)
        by def $function_inverse::is_right_inverse(G, cart(\orbit<G, X, act>(x), \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)), \orbit_stabilizer_forward<G, X, group, act, x>, \orbit_stabilizer_backward<G, X, group, act, x>)
    release thm function_inverse::surjective_of_right_inverse(G, cart(\orbit<G, X, act>(x), \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)), \orbit_stabilizer_forward<G, X, group, act, x>, \orbit_stabilizer_backward<G, X, group, act, x>)
    by def $bijective(G, cart(\orbit<G, X, act>(x), \stabilizer<G, X, act, group.one>(x)), \orbit_stabilizer_forward<G, X, group, act, x>)
